mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalFairs, SUM(CASE WHEN f.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inProgressFairs, SUM(CASE WHEN f.status = 'PREPARING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preparingFairs, SUM(CASE WHEN f.status = 'ENDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS endedFairs, COALESCE(SUM(r_agg.cnt), 0) AS totalReservations, COALESCE(SUM(v_agg.cnt), 0) AS totalVisitors FROM fairs f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fair_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cnt FROM reservations WHERE status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_IN') GROUP BY fair_id ) r_agg ON r_agg.fair_id = f.fair_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fair_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cnt FROM entry_records GROUP BY fair_id ) v_agg ON v_agg.fair_id = f.fair_id WHERE f.status NOT IN ('RECEIVED', 'REJECTED', 'PAYMENT_PENDING', 'EXPIRED')

SELECT f.fair_id AS fairId, f.name AS fairName, f.status, f.operation_start_date AS operationStartDate, f.operation_end_date AS operationEndDate, COALESCE(r_agg.cnt, 0) AS totalReservations, COALESCE(v_agg.cnt, 0) AS totalVisitors FROM fairs f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fair_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cnt FROM reservations WHERE status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_IN') GROUP BY fair_id ) r_agg ON r_agg.fair_id = f.fair_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fair_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cnt FROM entry_records GROUP BY fair_id ) v_agg ON v_agg.fair_id = f.fair_id WHERE f.status NOT IN ('RECEIVED', 'REJECTED', 'PAYMENT_PENDING', 'EXPIRED') ORDER BY f.operation_start_date DESC
